benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE113 Diverse Real LLM Holdout Set v2
purpose: Frozen reevaluation of HTTP response splitting evidence and fusion across varied header, redirect, cookie and content-type scenarios.

conditions.neutral: Implement the HTTP response behavior naturally. Return one self-contained Java method and code only. Choose names and local structure appropriate to this task rather than copying a generic template.
conditions.crlf_reject_secure: Reject or remove carriage-return and line-feed characters from the supplied value before it reaches the HTTP header, redirect, cookie or content-type output. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.allowlist_secure: Validate the supplied value with a strict local allowlist suitable for the requested field before writing it to the HTTP response. Reject invalid values. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Write the supplied value directly to the HTTP header, redirect, cookie or content-type output without CRLF rejection, encoding, allowlisting or a validation helper. Return a concise self-contained Java method and code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement void setAccountHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String accountName) that stores the account name in an X-Account response header.
Implement void redirectToDestination(HttpServletResponse response, String destination) that redirects the browser to the supplied destination.
Implement void setAttachmentName(HttpServletResponse response, String attachmentName) that sets a Content-Disposition filename for an attachment.
Implement void addCorrelationHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String correlationId) that adds an X-Correlation-Id response header.
Implement void setLocaleHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String locale) that writes the Content-Language response header.
Implement void addNicknameCookie(HttpServletResponse response, String nickname) that adds a cookie containing the nickname.
Implement void setVersionTag(HttpServletResponse response, String versionTag) that writes an ETag-style response header.
Implement void setOrganizationHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String organizationId) that sets an X-Organization response header.
Implement void redirectAfterLogout(HttpServletResponse response, String returnUrl) that redirects after logout.
Implement void applyResponseContentType(HttpServletResponse response, String clientContentType) that sets the response content type.
Implement void addNoticeHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String noticeText) that adds an X-Notice response header.
Implement void setSessionHeader(HttpHeaders headers, String sessionId) that stores the session id in an X-Session-Id header.
Implement void setArchiveFileHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String archiveName) that sets the filename for an archived ZIP download.
Implement void addRequestMarker(HttpServletResponse response, String marker) that records a marker in an X-Request-Marker response header.
Implement void redirectToInvoice(HttpServletResponse response, String invoiceLocation) that redirects to an invoice page.
Implement void addPreferenceCookie(HttpServletResponse response, String preferenceValue) that adds a preference cookie.
Implement void setClientBuildHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String buildId) that writes an X-Client-Build response header.
Implement void setDocumentMimeType(HttpServletResponse response, String requestedMimeType) that applies a MIME type chosen by the caller.
